import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=4)
# normalise village names
def norm(s):
    if pd.isna(s): return s
    s=str(s).strip()
    s=' '.join(s.split())
    return s
df['Village_norm']=df['Village'].apply(norm)
# deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
df_dedup=df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# sum
total = df_dedup['Women Reached'].sum() + df_dedup['Men Reached'].sum() + df_dedup['Children Reached'].sum()
print('rows original', len(df))
print('rows dedup', len(df_dedup))
print('total', total)
print(df_dedup[['Visit ID','Village','Village_norm']].head(10).to_string())
\""
